name: natively-interview-knowledge-mcp
description: Local MCP server that lets any MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, etc.) add companies and documents into Natively's free-tier Interview Knowledge base. Deliberately its own package with its own node_modules — the main app's better-sqlite3 build is rebuilt against Electron's ABI (see scripts/rebuild-native-electron.js), which is NOT compatible with a plain `node` process. This package installs its own plain-Node build instead, so the two never conflict.
